scope: Preference PATCH acknowledgment versus local presenter failure. HTTP fields,cache keys,codec and store actions unchanged.

red.behavior: Successful PATCH followed by rejected local presenter requeued the acknowledged patch and reported server-save failure;UI could not distinguish local apply error.

invariants: After successful account-validated PATCH,never requeue that acknowledged patch because presentation failed.
Persisted acknowledged snapshot retains committed values;pending cache contains only newer unsent edits.
Retry local presentation before flushing newer edits;repeated local failure does not resend committed settings.
Late presentation retry after account switch cannot apply old values or clear new account pending state.
Localized applyError distinguishes device application failure from failed server synchronization.
limits: Mounted store with real preference orchestration/presenter and mocked API/store endpoints;not real provider/offline/native/physical acceptance.
Initial bootstrap/load presentation failure remains a separate path;this change targets failures after acknowledged writes.
Whole RF13 and project acceptance remain open.
